rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Musk.
Exhibition name: Prosperity
rows.Origin:
Bred by Rev. Joseph Hardwick Pemberton (United Kingdom, 1919).
Introduced in Australia by Hazlewood Bros. Pty. Ltd. in 1921 as 'Prosperity'.
rows.Bloom: White, pink undertones. Moderate fragrance. Small to medium, semi-double (9-16 petals), in large clusters, rosette bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 3' to 10' (90 to 305cm). Width: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm).
